name: Honton Tange
original_name: 紅瞳譚歌～ホントンタンゲ～
source:
As main character returns from a part-time job, he is greeted by a girl lying in the bed in a seducing pose.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
